description:
Bracken Hale walks the road out past the wall twice a week and checks what's on it, and the hounds go with him. He's short a pair of hands this week.

It is a long walk in bad ground and the dogs do most of the work.
name: The Road and the Dogs

objectives.desc: Take the hounds off the wire at the Runs.
emotes: {who} gets the leads over their shoulder and lets four large animals decide how fast this is going to go.
{who} gets the wire gate open one-handed while a dozen animals decide whether to be interested.
{who} counts four leads out and puts the rest back on the peg.

objectives.desc: Walk the road out past the wall and check what's on it
emotes: {who} walks the line of poles, checking the fixings, straightening what has gone crooked in the wind.
{who} keeps the wall on one side for as long as there's wall, and then there's not.
{who} lets the dogs get out in front, because they know the ground and the ground is the difficulty.
